A '''service blade''' was an edged weapon that could be found in some [[Pilot/Legends|pilots']] survival gear. [[Ranna Gorjaye]] used a service blade to cut her way through the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] of the [[Wilds (corvaj)|Wilds]] after crashlanding on the [[Unidentified planet (Wilds)|planet]].
